name: zotero-semantic-search
description: Search your Zotero library by meaning and cite passages with page numbers.
long_description: Connects Claude to the Zotero Semantic Search plugin running in Zotero on this computer. Claude can find the passages in your PDFs that are closest in meaning to a query (in about 100 languages), read them in context, and get full bibliographic data and formatted citations. Everything stays on your computer: this extension only talks to Zotero's local server (127.0.0.1). Requires Zotero 7-10 with the Semantic Search plugin installed and running.
